name: My Pricing Table – build beautiful pricing tables in minutes
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Show your plans and prices beautifully – build a polished pricing table in a minute and embed it anywhere with a shortcode.

Live Demo

Why My Pricing Table?

My Pricing Table is a lightweight plugin that helps you create and embed beautiful pricing tables in a minute. Pick one of the built-in templates, set your prices and features, and paste the generated shortcode wherever you want the table to appear.

Every table can match your brand: choose your preferred colors and color scheme, use a custom currency symbol, and point the call-to-action button at any link with your own text.

Free Features

  • Easy to Use: Configure a table in minutes, no technical knowledge needed.
  • 5 Built-in Templates: Start from ready-made pricing table designs.
  • Custom Colors & Color Scheme: Use your preferred colors to match your site.
  • Custom Currency Symbol: Display prices in any currency.
  • Custom Call to Action: Set your own button text and link.
  • Shortcode Embedding: Place tables in any page, post, or widget.

How to Use

  1. Go to Pricing Table in your dashboard menu and click Add New Pricing Table.
  2. Configure the pricing table settings to your preference.
  3. Copy the generated shortcode.
  4. Paste it into any page, post, or widget where you want the table to appear.

Use Cases

  • SaaS & Subscription Sites: Compare plans side by side to help visitors choose.
  • Agencies & Freelancers: Present service packages with clear pricing.
  • Membership Sites: Show tier options with a clear call to action.

sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard (recommended):

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for “My Pricing Table”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to Pricing Table → Add New Pricing Table to build your first table.

Manual installation:

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the shortcode in any page, post, or widget.
  4. To embed in theme PHP, place <?php echo do_shortcode('YOUR_SHORTCODE'); ?> in your template.
sections.faq:
Is My Pricing Table free?

Yes, My Pricing Table is a free plugin.

How do I display a pricing table on a page?

Create a table under Pricing Table → Add New Pricing Table, copy the generated shortcode, and paste it into any page, post, or widget.

Can I change the currency symbol?

Yes, you can set a custom currency symbol for your prices.

Can I customize the button text and link?

Yes, each table supports a custom call-to-action text and link.

Can I use my own colors?

Yes. You can use your preferred colors and pick a color scheme to match your website.
